text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono says she's feeling pumped up 
today. She performs a shiko leg stomp to 
focus her mind for the showdown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking unusually fired up, she heads off 
to challenge the Swan Stakes!
